text:
maya: Heads-up — onboarding Mintaka-14B int4. Quick summary: latency OK, but we saw memory churn -> OOM on a few hosts and a modest QA drop in our summarization eval set. Trying to collect clues.
alex: saw the OOMs too. Pattern: small requests with high max_new_tokens (>=512) + batching set to 32. GPU mem fragmentation spikes before crash.
ravi: tagging infra. Which kernel/driver/torch combo was this run on?
maya: images: rtx-a6000-apo, driver 525.85, cuda 11.8. Runtime build: rw-runtime v1.8.2 with int4 kernels. CI runs on the same stack.
lucy: on quality: we ran the standard summarization suite (200 prompts). Mintaka int4 shows ~2.4 BLEU-equivalent drop on long-form summarization and occasional truncation artifacts near 450-600 tokens.
alex: that truncation aligns with KV-cache eviction. I think our default eviction threshold is hitting due to per-request max_new_tokens. We recently lowered slot-reserve for int4 to save memory.
maya: here are the configs we used in canary:
```
model: mintaka-14b-int4
batch_size: 32
max_new_tokens: 1024
slot_reserve_fraction: 0.06
prefix_cache: enabled
prefetch: true
```
alex: two quick hypotheses:
1) aggressive slot_reserve_fraction -> more fragmentation under interleaved small/big requests
2) large max_new_tokens with big batch increases peak KV memory then fallback eviction trips the kernel and causes truncation
ravi: infra note — the OOM hosts show lots of small allocations in the profiler before crash. Could be allocation churn due to our prefetch code for int4 path.
lucy: can we repro locally with smaller batch and step down max_new_tokens? I can re-run the eval sweep if you want.
maya: yes please. Plan proposal:
- Reduce batch to 8 for onboard canary
- Set max_new_tokens default to 256 for Mintaka int4 in hosted (for now)
- Increase slot_reserve_fraction to 0.12 for a soft roll (reduce fragmentation)
- Run targeted QA sweep on 200 long prompts + 100 short prompts
alex: also add a temporary KV-eviction logging flag to capture when eviction happens and why. We'll need traces to link truncation to eviction events.
ci-bot: deploy-log: canary config updated on cluster/zone-3 at 2025-11-03T14:12:04Z by maya
maya: I started a canary with batch=8, max_new_tokens=256, slot_reserve=0.12. Kickstarted eval run.
lucy: early results after 50 prompts: BLEU drop reduced to 0.5 on long-form, truncation events down to 2. Latency ~+8% p50, p95 stable.
alex: good sign. Ravi — logs still show fragmentation but no OOM within the sample window. Let's keep the conservative defaults while we iterate on kernel memory allocator.
ravi: filing infra ticket to debug prefetch path allocation pattern. Ticket: INFRA-1246. Attaching profiler snapshots.
maya: next steps:
- Promote safer defaults (batch 8 / max_new_tokens 256 / slot_reserve 0.12) for Mintaka on hosted as temporary mitigation
- Add eviction tracing + increase retention for the canary run
- Run a follow-up int4 quantization run with slightly different packing to test if packing reduces allocation churn
lucy: I'll run the full 200-prompt sweep overnight and post the report tomorrow morning.
alex: also putting a note in rollout playbook: "Mintaka-int4 initial defaults are conservative; watch for long-form QA and eviction logs."
maya: thanks all. If overnight sweep looks good we'll push the defaults and start a more aggressive perf rollout next week. :thumbsup:
